original_practice_blocks.heading: ## Investigate the failure boundary

paragraphs.text: Move an action down two lines and rerun. The stored citation must move too, while unrelated prose remains unassigned.

original_practice_blocks.heading: ## Investigate the failure boundary

paragraphs.text: Try approving an action whose owner is?. The inbox must reject approval, leaving the incomplete commitment for review.

original_practice_blocks.heading: ## Investigate the failure boundary

original_practice_blocks.heading: ## Investigate the failure boundary

paragraphs.text: Paste a script tag into a task. It must render as source text, and downloading decisions must contain only action ids and allowed decision values.

ACTION lines are authoritative candidates; NAME will TASK by YYYY-MM-DD is a conservative proposal grammar. Unstructured suggestions outside those grammars stay unassigned. HTML review does not post tasks or send messages.
